description: Revenue by owner + filter deal.org_id (JOIN owner + EXISTS deal)

result.sql_normalized: SELECT dataset_table_188.crm_name AS dataset_table_188_crm_name, SUM(dataset_table_193.amount) AS dataset_table_193_amount FROM (SELECT * FROM `bcfix`.`bc_revenue`) AS dataset_table_193 LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM `bcfix`.`bc_owner`) AS dataset_table_188 ON dataset_table_193.bc_key = dataset_table_188.bc_key WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT * FROM `bcfix`.`bc_owner`) AS dataset_table_188 INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM `bcfix`.`bc_deal`) AS dataset_table_190 ON dataset_table_188.bc_key = dataset_table_190.bc_key WHERE dataset_table_193.bc_key = dataset_table_188.bc_key AND dataset_table_190.org_id = 'O1') GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 10000000
